thread:
maya: :rotating_light: seeing a spike of customer errors and hallucinations on hosted/text-gen after the 02:00 deploy. Canary shows similar behavior. Errors mostly 500s + corrupted token streams. tagging oncall.
ops-bot: Paging oncall_ryan for channel incidents — severity 2. Incident created: INC-2026-1123.
oncall_ryan: I'm on it. quick ask: is this limited to a single model or rollout?
maya: Looks like we pushed v3.2.1 of the text-gen family. Canary was supposed to be 5% but telemetry shows 20% of traffic routed.
sven: I can pull canary logs. grabbing routing table and deploy events.
sven: quick tail: 
```
2026-03-15T02:07:12Z router: route apply canary=0.05 -> effective=0.20 reason=weights-auto-update
2026-03-15T02:07:13Z modelmgr: applied model weights from repo r/models@sha:ad4f3 -> active
2026-03-15T02:07:15Z tokenizer: loaded vocab v2 -> v3
```

sven: the router shows an auto-update process bumped canary higher; and modelmgr shows an unexpected model hash applied.
elaine: tokenizer v3? that would change tokenization and could corrupt streaming outputs in existing prompts. Were we supposed to flip tokenizer for v3.2.1?
irina: I see a config drift alert from config-sync: `models/text-gen/auto_update: true` was toggled on by CI job `model-updater/cron` at 02:06.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot notice: automatic model publish triggered by `model-updater` job.
oncall_ryan: ok scope: auto-update flipped on, pushed new model weights + tokenizer, routing bumped canary beyond intended. Customer impact: several PLG customers reported content corruption and completions with token splits. We should kill the rollout and rollback weights immediately.
maya: Agreed. can we flip the feature-flag `model_auto_rollout` to false globally? That's our fast kill switch.
sven: running: `redwood-ctl feature-flag set model_auto_rollout false --env hosted` -> response: success.
ops-bot: Feature-flag `model_auto_rollout` set to false by sven.
oncall_ryan: Initiating rollback of model hash to previous stable (sha:9b7c2). Executing: `modelctl rollback models/text-gen --to 9b7c2 --force`
sven: rollback in progress. tailing logs: 
```
2026-03-15T02:12:40Z modelmgr: initiating rollback to sha:9b7c2
2026-03-15T02:12:55Z modelmgr: weights restored (9b7c2)
2026-03-15T02:13:02Z tokenizer: reverted to vocab v2
2026-03-15T02:13:05Z router: canary back to 0.05
```

elaine: Observability shows tokenization errors dropping after 02:13. API error rate back to baseline.
irina: Confirmed: customer reports decrease in corrupted responses. Still seeing a few 500s for in-flight requests during rollback window.
maya: Noted customer impact window: 02:06-02:13 UTC. Affected customers: 4 PLG orgs (ids: org-118, org-322, org-415, org-501). Severity: degraded but recovered.
oncall_ryan: Good. Escalation: No PII leaked. No data plane compromise. Root cause looks like unintended auto-update of the staging model repo combined with a router bug that increased effective canary weight when auto-update triggers.
sven: I created a quick diff from the `model-updater` job run: it sent `auto_update=true` due to a stale flag in the cron job's template. Posting snippet: 
```
- schedule: daily
- job: model-updater/cron
- payload: {"models":["text-gen"], "auto_update": true}
```

ops-bot: Note: deploy-bot shows `model-updater/cron` last changed by pipeline #842 on 2026-03-14 by user `ci-bot` (merge: infra/auto-update-fix).
irina: That merge mistakenly set default `auto_update=true` to make manual QA easier. CI didn't gate on the routing policy so it flipped live.
oncall_ryan: Mitigation checklist: 1) feature-flag off (done), 2) rollback (done), 3) pin canary routing fix to prevent weight inflation (in progress by sven), 4) notify customers + SRE postmortem.
maya: I'll prepare a short customer-facing note: timeline, impact, and mitigation. irm: can you help triage support threads?
irina: will coordinate support escalation and badge affected orgs.
sven: pushing a protection: change router to ignore weight updates from `model-updater` until `manual_approve=true` is present. patching PR now.
oncall_ryan: Confirming service health: 02:20 all systems green, error rate baseline. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved until postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1123 status updated: mitigated -> investigation continuing.
maya: Quick follow-ups for postmortem: - revert auto_update default to false in CI templates - add CI gating to require explicit `manual_approve` for live rollouts - add unit test for tokenizer compatibility across model versions - add alert to detect sudden effective canary weight changes
irina: I'll own the customer通知 and compliance note. Also will create a ticket to ensure audit logs show who flipped flags.
sven: PR opened: infra#529 - router ignores auto-update weight changes.
oncall_ryan: Handoff: I'm on-call for another 15m, then ryan_2 will take over. leaving notes in the incident runbook.
maya: thanks all. reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:
deploy-bot: Deploy event: rollback to 9b7c2 completed by oncall_ryan at 2026-03-15T02:13:05Z.
ops-bot: Closing note: postmortem owners assigned: maya (customer comm), sven (routing fix), irina (CI template & audit).
maya: will draft postmortem and share in #postmortems; tagging product and legal for any downstream impact.
